import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from torch.utils.cpp_extension import load_inline

# Kernel source for tiled matrix multiplication (float32)
matmul_cuda_source = """
__global__ void gemm_kernel_fast(const float* A, const float* B, float* C, int M, int K, int N) {
    // Each thread computes one element C[i][j] = sum_l A[i][l] * B[l][j]
    int i = blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
    int j = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
    if (i < M && j < N) {
        float sum = 0.0f;
        for (int l = 0; l < K; ++l) {
            sum += A[i * K + l] * B[l * N + j];
        }
        C[i * M + j] = sum;
    }
}
"""

# Load the inline CUDA function for matmul
matmul = load_inline(
    name="matmul",
    cpp_sources="",
    cuda_sources=matmul_cuda_source,
    functions=["matmul_cuda"],
    verbose=True,
    extra_cflags=[],
    extra_ldflags=[],
)

class ModelNew(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.matmul = matmul  # type: ignore

    def forward(self, A: torch.Tensor, B: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        # Perform matrix multiplication A @ B using the custom CUDA kernel
        return self.matmul.matmul_cuda(A, B)

def get_inputs():
    M = 8205
    K = 2949
    N = 5921
    A = torch.rand(M, K).cuda()
    B = torch.rand(K, N).cuda()
    return [A, B]

if __name__ == "__main__":
    # Quick sanity check (not part of submission)
    model = ModelNew()
    out = model(get_inputs())
